TransportOptions.summary: Opaque JSON-like bag for kind-specific transport knobs (timeouts, OData batch, Neo4j auth extras, …). Top-level `@transport` args stay shared; protocol details go here.
TransportOptions.authors: Pass only keys your transport documents. Unknown keys may be ignored or rejected by a strict executor.
TransportOptions.implementers: Map 1:1 onto Hive `TransportEntry.options`. Do not add sibling `@transport` args for kind-specific fields — nest under `options`.

_HoistConfig.summary: Serialized hoist path (string list and/or `{ fieldName, filterArgs }` objects) describing how a nested field was lifted.
_HoistConfig.authors: Usually emitted by the hoist transform, not hand-written.
_HoistConfig.implementers: Preserve through composition so Gateway / Connectors selection rewrites can re-apply the path. Treat as structured JSON, not free text.

ResolveToSourceArgs.summary: Map of argument name → value expression (often with `{root…}` / `{args…}` interpolation) forwarded when delegating to a source field.
ResolveToSourceArgs.authors: Use object syntax in SDL: `sourceArgs: { id: "{root.id}" }`.
ResolveToSourceArgs.implementers: Parse as a string-keyed map. Interpolate with the same resolver-data rules as Mesh additional resolvers before calling the source field.

@transport.summary: Declares how Gateway reaches a subgraph: kind, location, optional headers, and kind-specific `options`. Repeatable on SCHEMA so one schema document can describe multiple subgraphs.

authors.intro: Every non-Connectors Mesh subgraph should carry `@transport` (often stamped by the loader). Pair protocol field directives (`@sql`, `@mongo__*`, …) with a matching `kind`. Do not use this for HTTP/REST Connectors `@source(http:)` — that lives under specs.apollo.dev/connect.

implementers.compose: Loaders stamp via `importMeshDirectives(..., ["@transport"])` on the core URL. Compose may rewrite or drop pure-http transports that duplicate `join__graph` URLs, or rewrite non-http transports into `join__directive` for Apollo-safe SG printing while keeping a reconstitutable definition.
implementers.loaders: Always stamp `subgraph` + `kind`. Put protocol-only knobs in `options`, not new top-level args.
implementers.runtime: Build a transport entry map from SCHEMA apps. Reject unsupported Mesh `@link` versions. Executors select by `kind` then read `location` / `headers` / `options`.

subgraph.constraints: Non-empty; must uniquely identify the subgraph in the composed graph.
subgraph.authors: Name of the Mesh subgraph this entry configures.
subgraph.implementers: Key into the transport entry map and match protocol directive `subgraph:` args.

kind.authors: Selects which executor implementation Gateway loads.
kind.implementers: Dispatch table key. Do not overload `kind` with options — use `options` for variants.

location.constraints: URI / DSN / endpoint string understood by that kind (Postgres URL, Mongo URI, Thrift HTTP endpoint, …).
location.authors: Where to connect. May be omitted when Gateway config injects the endpoint.
location.implementers: May be dropped from printed SG when it duplicates `join__graph(url:)` for pure HTTP. Still required at execution unless overridden by gateway config.

headers.constraints: List of `[name, value]` pairs (or ObjMap round-trip in some loaders). Values may include interpolations depending on transport.
headers.authors: Static default headers for upstream calls.
headers.implementers: Normalize to `TransportEntry.headers`. Merge with per-request headers without dropping security header partitioning rules (e.g. OData batch).

options.constraints: Must be valid `TransportOptions` for the chosen `kind`.
options.authors: Kind-specific config (timeouts, query string defaults, OData batch mode, …).
options.implementers: Pass through as `TransportEntry.options`. Document per-transport keys in that transport package — not as new `@transport` args.

@source.summary: Mesh stitching provenance: records the original subgraph type/field name when renames occur. Not Connectors `@source(http:)` from specs.apollo.dev/connect.

authors.intro: Usually stamped by Compose when types/fields are renamed. When Connectors `@source` is also present, Mesh may alias this as `@meshSource` via `@link(as:)`.

implementers.compose: Emit on renamed elements; keep `subgraph` aligned with transport entries. Alias to `@meshSource` if Apollo Connectors `@source` shares the schema.
implementers.runtime: Use to recover original names for executor selection / error coordinates. Ignore Connectors `http:` shape — different directive.

name.constraints: Original type or field name in the source subgraph.
name.implementers: Lookup key for reverse rename / coordinate mapping.

type.constraints: Original GraphQL type string when field types were rewritten.
type.authors: Rarely hand-set; Compose fills when needed.
type.implementers: Restore printed types when projecting back to the subgraph schema.

subgraph.authors: Which source owned the original name.
subgraph.implementers: Scope provenance per subgraph; repeatable apps accumulate across sources.

@resolveTo.summary: Gateway-level field binder: resolve this field by delegating to another source field, a batch key lookup, and/or a PubSub topic (webhooks / subscriptions).

authors.intro: Primary tool for schema extensions that stitch across subgraphs without hand-written JS resolvers. See Mesh schema-extensions docs for end-to-end patterns.

implementers.compose: Encapsulate / additionalTypeDefs import `@resolveTo` under core when used. Preserve args through SG printing.
implementers.runtime: Convert each app into an additional resolver (`resolveAdditionalResolvers`). Support batching via `keyField`/`keysArg`/`valueKeyField`, PubSub via `pubsubTopic`, and result projection via `result` / `filterBy`.

requiredSelectionSet.constraints: GraphQL selection set string on the parent object that must be fetched before delegation.
requiredSelectionSet.authors: Guarantee parent fields used in `sourceArgs` (e.g. `{ id }`).
requiredSelectionSet.implementers: Merge into the parent selection set when planning.

sourceName.defaults: Optional for pure PubSub; required for source delegation.
sourceName.authors: Which subgraph executes the source field.

sourceTypeName.defaults: Required for source delegation; omit only for pure PubSub. No runtime default (does not fall back to `Query`).
sourceTypeName.constraints: Type that owns `sourceFieldName` in the source schema (commonly `Query`, `Mutation`, or `Subscription` when those are the owners).
sourceTypeName.authors: Must name the source type that owns the delegated field. Omitting it for delegation makes runtime look up an undefined type and throw.
sourceTypeName.implementers: Call `schema.getType(sourceTypeName)` then the field; do not invent a default type name.

sourceFieldName.constraints: Field name on the source type.

sourceSelectionSet.constraints: Selection set string to request from the source field.
sourceSelectionSet.authors: Shape the delegated selection when it differs from the client selection.
sourceSelectionSet.implementers: Apply when building the delegated operation.

sourceArgs.authors: Map parent/args into source field arguments.
sourceArgs.implementers: Interpolate then pass as GraphQL args.

keyField.constraints: Parent field path used as batch keys.
keyField.authors: Enable batch delegation from a list of keys on the parent.
keyField.implementers: Collect keys for batching; pair with `keysArg`.

keysArg.constraints: Source argument that accepts the batch keys array.
keysArg.authors: Name of the list argument on the source field.
keysArg.implementers: Pass collected keys into this arg.

valueKeyField.constraints: Field path on each source result used to match keys (order-independent batching).
valueKeyField.authors: Use when the source may return gaps, duplicates, or unordered rows relative to keys.
valueKeyField.implementers: Index results by this field; still request the field even if the client omitted it.

pubsubTopic.constraints: PubSub topic string; webhook form `webhook:METHOD:path` binds HTTP callbacks when Gateway `webhooks` is enabled.
pubsubTopic.authors: Subscribe/publish bridge for subscriptions without a source field.
pubsubTopic.implementers: Wire `context.pubsub` subscribe/publish; register webhook routes for `webhook:` topics.

filterBy.constraints: Expression evaluated against payload / args to filter subscription events.
filterBy.authors: Limit which PubSub payloads reach the subscriber.

additionalArgs.defaults: Optional; honored only on the batch path (`keysArg` present).
additionalArgs.constraints: `ResolveToSourceArgs` map. Without `keysArg`, the non-batch resolver reads only `sourceArgs` and silently ignores `additionalArgs`.
additionalArgs.authors: Use for extra args on batched delegation. For ordinary (non-batch) delegation, put those values in `sourceArgs` instead.
additionalArgs.implementers: Merge into batch call args when `keysArg` is set; do not apply on the non-batch branch.

result.constraints: Dot path into the source payload to return.
result.authors: Project a nested property as the field value.
result.implementers: Apply lodash-style path get on the resolver result.

resultType.constraints: Type name hint when the projected result needs an explicit runtime type.
resultType.authors: Rare; use when projection changes the effective type.
resultType.implementers: Use when wrapping / asserting return types in additional resolvers.

@hoist.summary: Records that a field was hoisted from a nested path onto a parent type. Repeatable on FIELD_DEFINITION.

authors.intro: Emitted by the hoist-field Compose transform. Prefer configuring the transform over hand-writing `@hoist`.

implementers.compose: Transform adds the field and stamps `@hoist` with `pathConfig` for downstream Connectors selection rewrites.
implementers.runtime: Follow `pathConfig` when mapping selections back to the nested source shape.

subgraph.defaults: Optional locally; loaders usually stamp the subgraph name when composing.
subgraph.constraints: String subgraph name. When present, must match the owning Mesh subgraph / `@transport(subgraph:)` entry used at runtime.
subgraph.authors: Identify which Mesh subgraph owns this annotation when several sources are composed. Omit for single-source hand SDL if the loader will stamp it.
subgraph.implementers: Compose and join rewrites use `subgraph` to attribute directive apps. Transports filter apps by the active subgraph. Never invent a second name for the same source.

pathConfig.defaults: Required for any executable `@hoist` app. The hoist transform always stamps it; omitting it makes Gateway call `.map` on `undefined` during subgraph transform setup and fail schema init.
pathConfig.constraints: `_HoistConfig` — non-empty array of field names and/or `{ fieldName, filterArgs }` objects.
pathConfig.authors: Do not hand-write `@hoist` without `pathConfig`. Prefer the hoist-field transform, which emits the path.
pathConfig.implementers: Require an array before building `HoistField` transforms; drive selection rewrites along the path.
